cuts.ofreeRecent: a circus tent ring under a striped canopy — standing; a retro American diner — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a convention photo zone under ring lights — raises a camera to her eye to take a photo; the nave of a Gothic cathedral with stained-glass windows — sitting on the ground; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — brings a cup to her lips; overgrown jungle temple ruins — holds a small bouquet at chest height; an airport lounge — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a desert oasis at golden hour — standing; a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — places a stone on a go board with black and white stones on the table; a medieval tavern — carries a small red paper lantern by its cord; an open-air hot spring among steaming rocks — holds a folding fan open near her chest; a sunlit white marble temple — standing; a Three Kingdoms film-set street — standing
